title: 500WS Eat Lunch
bodyHtml:
500WS Eat Lunch with Sabine Höfler

Sabine Höfler is member of the scientific staff (promotion of early career researchers, dual career, work-life-balance) and also part of the Office for Gender Equality at the University of Bern.

​

On the 19th of May 2022, we had the chance to dicuss with her about hiring processes at Swiss Universities and how new measurements are being implemented.

​

If you want to know more about these topics, contact her by e-mail: 

sabine.hoefler@unibe.ch

"500WS eat lunch" is a series of networking events in which our members have the opportunity to meet women leaders in academia, industry, funding bodies and research institutions and discuss career strategies with them and get valuable advice and insights.
